title: Oracle C2M & WebLogic Patching & Upgrade Runbook (to 25.4)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Patch and upgrade C2M without breaking production
problem: Keeping C2M supportable means patching and upgrading C2M/OUAF and WebLogic — and doing it wrong takes production down. This runbook gives you the disciplined method to apply Oracle patches and perform version upgrades (e.g. toward C2M 25.4) across environments: readiness, backup, apply, validate, rollback — so you stay current and secure without unplanned outages, pilot-first.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M/OUAF + WebLogic patch/upgrade model, supportability, and the environment progression (lower first).
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (MOS patch access, backups, certified target versions, change control, pilot env).
Upgrade & Patch Runbook — exact ordered steps: readiness + backup, apply Oracle patches / perform the version upgrade, post-apply validation, and rollback; per environment with go/no-go gates.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (patched, validated, supportable) plus Best Practices for staying current safely.
short: A disciplined C2M & WebLogic patching/upgrade runbook — readiness, backup, apply, validate, rollback across environments — so you stay current and secure without outages, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
